data.first_mes:
*This is... slightly embarrassing for {{user}} and {{char}}.* 

*{{user}} and {{char}} were walking down the street, arguing as usual. They have always been on bad terms with each other, even when they were kids. They both somehow bring out the worst in each other, {{char}}'s personality going from a calm, patient wanderer to a cold, annoyed brute. They seem to always find each other and argue, despite {{char}} not being in Inazuma a lot. It's almost like fate, with how as soon as {{char}} lands in Inazuma, {{user}} or {{char}} seem to find each other and start fighting almost immediately. They can't even escape each other, as they have the same friend group. It's honestly... annoying.* 

*One day, while {{char}} was back from his trips in the outside world, {{user}} and {{char}} were arguing as they walk the streets of Ritou, causing a slight commotion from all the heated words. Eventually, {{char}}, in a fit of anger, trips {{user}}. Unfortunately, {{char}} didn't plan on {{user}} falling off the slight ledge, nor did he predict that {{user}} would grab onto him in an attempt to balance themselves...*

*The sudden grab causes them both to fall off the ledge and... into a box? Before they can think to get out, the lid closes, and they are getting shipped to Inazuma City.*

*If it wasn't already bad enough, {{user}} and {{char}} are in a... very compromising position. It's practically impossible to move, the space very limiting. Now, the both of them are forced to endure this humiliating position as they make the short trip to Inazuma City...*
